class.name: MarkdownTheme
class.brief_description: Typography, color palette, box metrics, [StyleBox] overrides, and callout definitions for [MarkdownView].
class.description: A reusable [Resource] that controls every visual aspect of a [MarkdownView]. Use [method create_dark] or [method create_light] for ready-made presets, or save a custom [code].tres[/code] resource in the Inspector. Fonts fall back gracefully: if [member regular_font] is [code]null[/code], [MarkdownView] uses Godot's default UI font; if [member bold_font], [member italic_font], or [member bold_italic_font] are [code]null[/code], synthetic [FontVariation] faces (embolden and/or oblique slant) are generated automatically. Any property change—including edits to a [MarkdownCalloutStyle] stored inside [member callouts]—emits [signal Resource.changed] so attached [MarkdownView] controls re-layout and redraw immediately.

method.name: create_dark
method.description: Creates and returns a new [MarkdownTheme] initialized with the built-in dark color palette and dark-mode callout presets.

method.name: create_light
method.description: Creates and returns a new [MarkdownTheme] initialized with the built-in light color palette and light-mode callout presets.

method.name: get_callout_style
method.description: Returns the [MarkdownCalloutStyle] registered for [param kind] (trimmed and matched case-insensitively). If no explicit entry exists, returns a synthesized fallback [MarkdownCalloutStyle] with a capitalized title and [member blockquote_accent_color] (or [member muted_color]) as its accent color.

method.name: get_heading_scale
method.description: Returns the font-size multiplier for heading [param level] (clamped to [code]1..6[/code]). Falls back to the built-in default scale ([code]1.85, 1.5, 1.25, 1.1, 1.0, 0.9[/code]) if [member heading_scales] does not contain a positive value for that level.

method.name: set_callout_style
method.description: Registers or updates the [MarkdownCalloutStyle] for [param kind] (trimmed and normalized to uppercase). Passing [code]null[/code] removes any registered style for [param kind]. Connects [signal Resource.changed] on the style so subsequent edits invalidate the theme.

members.member: Base body font size in pixels (clamped to at least [code]1[/code]). Heading sizes, code sizes, and all [code]*_em[/code] spacing metrics scale relative to this value.
Color of the vertical left accent bar drawn on blockquotes, and the default fallback accent color for unregistered callout kinds.
Width in pixels of the vertical left accent bar on blockquotes. Set to [code]0.0[/code] to hide the accent bar.
Background fill color for blockquotes when [member blockquote_style] is [code]null[/code]. Set alpha to [code]0.0[/code] for a transparent background.
Outer horizontal indentation factor for blockquotes, scaled by [member base_font_size].
Inner padding in pixels around blockquote content.
Optional [StyleBox] drawn behind blockquotes. When [code]null[/code], a procedural rounded panel using [member blockquote_bg_color] and [member corner_radius] is drawn.
Optional bold font used for headings, strong emphasis, callout titles, and table headers. When [code]null[/code], a synthetic emboldened [FontVariation] is derived from [member regular_font].
Optional bold-italic font. When [code]null[/code], a synthetic [FontVariation] is derived from [member bold_font], [member italic_font], or [member regular_font].
Width in pixels of the vertical left accent bar on callout panels.
Width and height in pixels of the callout header icon (clamped to at least [code]4.0[/code]).
Inner padding in pixels around callout header and body content.

Dictionary mapping uppercase callout kind strings (such as [code]"NOTE"[/code], [code]"TIP"[/code], [code]"IMPORTANT"[/code], [code]"WARNING"[/code], [code]"CAUTION"[/code]) to [MarkdownCalloutStyle] resources. Keys assigned through [method set_callouts] are trimmed and uppercased, and non-[MarkdownCalloutStyle] values are ignored.
Background fill color for fenced and indented code blocks when [member code_block_style] is [code]null[/code].
Inner padding in pixels around code block text.
Optional [StyleBox] drawn behind code blocks. When [code]null[/code], a procedural rounded panel using [member code_bg_color], [member rule_color], and [member corner_radius] is drawn.
Multiplier applied to the surrounding font size for inline code spans and code blocks (clamped to at least [code]0.1[/code]).
Foreground text color for inline code spans and code blocks.
Corner radius in pixels used by procedural rounded panels (code blocks, blockquotes, callouts, tables, and inline code pills up to [code]4.0[/code] px).
Vertical spacing in ems inserted after a heading block before the next sibling block.
Text color used for headings ([code]H1[/code]–[code]H6[/code]) and table header cells.
Font-size multipliers for heading levels 1 through 6, applied to [member base_font_size]. Missing or non-positive entries fall back to the defaults via [method get_heading_scale].
Vertical spacing in ems inserted above a heading block when it is not the first block in its container.
Background fill color for inline code pills when [member inline_code_style] is [code]null[/code].
Horizontal padding in pixels added on each side of inline code spans.
Vertical padding in pixels expanding inline code pill backgrounds above and below the line height.
Optional [StyleBox] drawn behind inline code spans. When [code]null[/code], a procedural rounded pill using [member inline_code_bg_color] is drawn.
Target height of inline images expressed as a multiple of the surrounding font size (clamped to at least [code]0.1[/code]).
Optional italic font. When [code]null[/code], a synthetic slanted [FontVariation] is derived from [member regular_font].
Extra vertical spacing in pixels inserted between wrapped lines inside paragraphs, headings, tables, and code blocks.
Text and underline color for hyperlinks in their resting state.
Text and underline color for the currently hovered hyperlink.
Horizontal indentation per list nesting level in ems (clamped to at least [code]0.25[/code]). Also reserves space for bullets, numbers, or task checkboxes.
Vertical spacing in ems between items in a tight list. Loose lists use [member paragraph_spacing_em].
Maximum rendered height in pixels for standalone block images (clamped to at least [code]1.0[/code]). Aspect ratio is preserved when downscaling.
Optional monospace font for inline code and code blocks. Falls back to [member regular_font] (or Godot's default font) when [code]null[/code].
Secondary color used for list markers, unresolved image alt text, code-block scroll thumbs, and blockquote/strikethrough tint blending.
Vertical spacing in ems between consecutive sibling blocks (paragraphs, lists, tables, code blocks, callouts, and loose list items).
Optional base body font. When [code]null[/code], [MarkdownView] falls back to the control's default theme font.
Color of thematic breaks ([code]---[/code]) and the default 1 px border around procedural code blocks.
Height in pixels of thematic break horizontal rules (clamped to at least [code]0.5[/code]).
Stroke color of the horizontal line drawn through [code]~~strikethrough~~[/code] spans.
Background fill color applied to alternating body rows in tables. Set alpha to [code]0.0[/code] to disable zebra striping.
Color of table outer borders and internal horizontal/vertical cell dividers.
Preferred horizontal padding in pixels on each side of a table cell. Automatically clamped on very narrow tables so every column keeps at least [code]1.0[/code] px of text width.
Vertical padding in pixels above and below content inside each table cell.
Background fill color for table header rows when [member table_header_style] is [code]null[/code].
Optional [StyleBox] drawn behind table header rows instead of [member table_header_bg_color].
Optional [StyleBox] drawn as the outer frame of tables. When [code]null[/code], a procedural rounded border using [member table_border_color] and [member corner_radius] is drawn.
Fill color of checked task-list checkboxes ([code]- [x][/code]).
Outline color of unchecked task-list checkboxes ([code]- [ ][/code]).
Default body text color for paragraphs, lists, table cells, and callout bodies.
